name: next-steps-autopilot
description: A What next? button above the prompt box asks for suggested next prompts only when pressed. Type /auto to have suggestion 1 sent after a countdown you set; off by default.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to offer What next? after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip the What next? button after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

autoSeconds.title: Auto mode countdown (seconds)
autoSeconds.description: How long /auto waits before sending suggestion 1. 0 sends at once. /auto <seconds> changes it for one session.
